name: PRESIDENTIAL PLAYTHINGS
clue: A 1902 cartoon of a president who refused to shoot a captured bruin inspired this cuddly toy named for him

name: PRACTICALLY PERFECT PAGES
clue: P.L. Travers' 1934 book about a nanny who blows in on the east wind became this beloved 1964 Disney film

name: THE LONGEST NAP
clue: Washington Irving's Rip Van Winkle slept 20 years in the Catskills and missed this entire war

name: CATALOG OF CHRISTMAS
clue: Copywriter Robert May created this famous misfit for a 1939 Montgomery Ward giveaway booklet

name: BREAKFAST OF BROTHERS
clue: Two brothers running a health sanitarium in Battle Creek, Michigan, gave America this crunchy breakfast cereal

name: THE LANDLORDS
clue: Vivian Vance and William Frawley played this couple, Lucy and Ricky's landlords and best friends

name: LET FREEDOM RING
clue: Shipped from a London foundry in 1752, this Philadelphia icon cracked on its very first test ring and had to be recast

name: FROM FRANCE, WITH LOVE
clue: Shipped across the Atlantic in 1885 in 214 crates, this copper colossus was riveted back together on Bedloe's Island

name: HUCKLEBERRY FRIEND
clue: Audrey Hepburn sang 'Moon River' on a fire escape, guitar in hand, in this 1961 film

name: THE CREAM OF THE CROP
clue: Bananas ran short during World War II, so this golden Hostess snack cake switched to a vanilla cream filling
